text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Vision guided CloseDrawer controller for the single live RoboCasa episode.
+
+Run interactively and send one JSON command per line. Each motion is recorded in
+trajectory.jsonl, and each observation is saved under captures/. Commands:
+  {"repeat": 10, "action": [12 channel values], "note": "..."}
+  {"actions": [[...], ...], "note": "..."}
+  {"observe": true}
+  {"status": true}
+
+The controller only consumes camera images, calibration, and robot proprioception.
+"""
+
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+ROOT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+CAPTURES = ROOT / "captures"
+CAMERAS = [
+    "robot0_agentview_center",
+    "robot0_agentview_left",
+    "robot0_agentview_right",
+    "robot0_eye_in_hand",
+]
+
+
+def save_result(result, label):
+    path = CAPTURES / label
+    result.save(str(path))
+    layout = result.meta["proprio"]["layout"]
+    vals = result.meta["proprio"]["now"]
+    p = dict(zip(layout, vals))
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "path": str(path),
+        "steps": result.meta["control_steps"],
+        "time_left_s": result.meta["time_left_s"],
+        "done": result.meta["done"],
+        "eef": [p["eef_right_x"], p["eef_right_y"], p["eef_right_z"]],
+        "base": [p["mobilebase0_joint_mobile_forward_pos"],
+                 p["mobilebase0_joint_mobile_side_pos"],
+                 p["mobilebase0_joint_mobile_yaw_pos"]],
+        "torso": p["mobilebase0_joint_torso_height_pos"],
+    }), flush=True)
+
+
+def main():
+    CAPTURES.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    robot = Robot()
+    print("READY", json.dumps({"dt": robot.spec()["control_dt"]}), flush=True)
+    counter = 0
+    while True:
+        line = sys.stdin.readline()
+        if not line:
+            break
+        try:
+            cmd = json.loads(line)
+            if cmd.get("status"):
+                print(json.dumps(robot.status()), flush=True)
+                continue
+            if cmd.get("observe"):
+                res = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="none")
+            else:
+                if "actions" in cmd:
+                    actions = np.asarray(cmd["actions"], dtype=np.float64)
+                else:
+                    actions = np.tile(np.asarray(cmd["action"], dtype=np.float64),
+                                      (int(cmd.get("repeat", 1)), 1))
+                if actions.ndim != 2 or actions.shape[1] != 12:
+                    raise ValueError("Expected (T, 12) actions")
+                before = robot.status()["control_steps"]
+                res = robot.submit("ee_delta", actions, cameras=CAMERAS,
+                                   include_depth=True, video="none",
+                                   interpolate="hold", note=cmd.get("note", ""))
+                with (ROOT / "trajectory.jsonl").open("a") as f:
+                    f.write(json.dumps({"before_steps": before,
+                                        "after_steps": res.meta["control_steps"],
+                                        "note": cmd.get("note", ""),
+                                        "actions": actions.tolist()}) + "\n")
+            counter += 1
+            save_result(res, f"{counter:03d}")
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print("ERROR", repr(exc), flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch"));
